title: Submit, observe, cancel, and collect a process job
summary: A bounded OGC API Processes lifecycle with one raw server contract and truthful language-specific lifecycle differences.

maturity.supportTier: Community server; SDK maturity varies by language
evidence: honua-server OGC process route contract tests
limitations: Python OGC Processes support is source preview and not yet published to PyPI.
.NET exposes lifecycle methods but no bounded wait-to-terminal helper.
DELETE is best-effort job cancellation; Honua Server does not claim the full OGC dismiss conformance class.

server.auth: API key or bearer token when configured; fixture transports use a non-secret local endpoint.

protocols.notes: The gallery fixture must pin all four exchanges and verify paths, status progression, cancellation behavior, and result key.

server.cancellation: DELETE /ogc/processes/jobs/{jobId} is best-effort cancellation; caller-side abort only stops the in-flight HTTP request.
server.errors: Non-success terminal state, polling deadline/attempt exhaustion, auth failure, invalid process input, and transport failure remain distinct outcomes.

semantics.assertion: Require a Location/jobID receipt, only legal status transitions, a successful terminal state before result retrieval, outputFeatureLayer in results, and a DELETE receipt when the cancellation path is exercised.

codeTabs.code:
from honua_sdk import HonuaClient

with HonuaClient('http://127.0.0.1:8080', timeout=10.0) as client:
    gp = client.geoprocessing()
    job = gp.submit_inputs('geometry.buffer', inputs)
    terminal = gp.wait(job, poll_interval=0.5, timeout=30.0)
    result = gp.results(terminal.job_id)
    # Operator cancellation path only: gp.dismiss(job.job_id)

walkthrough.title: Inspect the server contract
walkthrough.action: Review the process id, raw request, authentication, bounds, and pinned fixture before choosing a language.
walkthrough.expectedOutcome: The exact POST and lifecycle routes are visible and copyable.

walkthrough.title: Submit asynchronously
walkthrough.action: POST geometry.buffer with Prefer: respond-async and capture both Location and jobID.
walkthrough.expectedOutcome: A non-empty job identity with accepted status.

walkthrough.title: Observe bounded progress
walkthrough.action: Poll or watch with a cancellation primitive, 30-second deadline, and 20-attempt ceiling.
walkthrough.expectedOutcome: Only accepted, running, and a legal terminal status are observed.

walkthrough.title: Approve cancellation when needed
walkthrough.action: Invoke DELETE/dismiss only from an explicit operator action; do not treat request abort as server cancellation.
walkthrough.expectedOutcome: A cancellation receipt or a truthful best-effort failure.

walkthrough.title: Collect and assert results
walkthrough.action: Fetch results only after successful status and verify outputFeatureLayer.
walkthrough.expectedOutcome: A result artifact tied to the submitted job receipt.

console.requiredRole: operator with process/job read; cancellation requires the deployment's job-control permission

ai.validation: A future AI draft must normalize to the same raw process request and bounds shown in the server panel before approval.
ai.approvalBoundary: Submission, cancellation, deletion, publication, and cleanup always require explicit human approval; planning alone has no effect.
